description: <attemptDir>/steps/<stepId>.json. Published once by the step runner (supervisor or adopt) only after the step process exited 0 and printed a done result. A missing receipt means the step must run (again); every step is idempotent.

fields.detail: object or absent; the step's own stdout result minus anything secret

stepProcess.argv: <step.hostBin> <step.argv...>, cwd step.cwd, env exactly step.env (no inheritance from the runner)
stepProcess.fds: stdin /dev/null; stdout one JSON line; stderr appended to supervisor.log; no other fd: the step never receives a lock description

retry.reason: string, e.g. credential-home-kept; no receipt, adopt retries later

stepProcess.timeout: the runner kills the step's process group after stepTimeoutMs; no receipt

order: steps run in envelope order; a step without a receipt stops the chain for this runner (the attempt stays open for adopt)
